name: wave-text-reveal
title: Wave Text Reveal
description: A headline phrase whose characters oscillate in an undulated sine wave rhythm before locking into typography baseline.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Sinusoidal Glyph Wave: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
